player_prompt.intro:
Uri Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) michezoni ya Matching Pennies inayochezwa kwa mizunguko ya {num_rounds}.
- Mzunguko wowote, tuma [heads] kana [tails] (kana [h], [t]).
- Kana uchaguo wako ukafanana na uchaguo wa mshindani wako, Mchezaji 0 anoshinda mzunguko huo; kana asifanane Mchezaji 1 anoshinda.
Dhinda na uchaguo wako ukiwa uko katika mfumo wa '[heads]' kana '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 akachagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 akachagua {choice1}. Kufanana -> Mchezaji 0 anoshinda
message.round_mismatch: Mutambo 0 akasarudza {choice0}; Mutambo 1 akasarudza {choice1}. Hazvisi zvakafanana -> Mutambo 1 anohwinha.
